resources.string: First I will ask for three permissions: microphone, camera and notifications. For each window, choose Allow.

Next step. Press the button at the bottom of the screen. In the list, find SENTIA volume keys, turn it on and confirm. If the phone refuses, open the SENTIA app info, tap the three dots at the top right, choose Allow restricted settings, then try again. Then come back here.
It is not turned on yet. Press the button, find SENTIA volume keys, and turn it on. Or choose Later.
All set. To wake me, press Volume up quickly three times, or shake the phone.
Next step. Press the button at the bottom. In the list, touch SENTIA, then turn on Display over other apps. This lets SENTIA open when you wake it. Then come back here.
It is not turned on yet. Press the button, touch SENTIA and turn on the switch. Or choose Later.
Last step. Press the button, then choose Allow. This stops the phone from putting SENTIA to sleep. Then come back here.
It is not allowed yet. Press the button, then choose Allow. Or choose Later.
